summary: Mistras Group filed an 8-K disclosing a September 17, 2026 Agreement and Plan of Merger with Athena Purchaser, LLC and Athena Merger Sub, Inc., controlled by H.I.G. Capital funds. The merger converts each outstanding share into $20.35 cash, with the Company surviving as a wholly owned H.I.G. subsidiary. The Board unanimously approved the deal, deemed it fair and in stockholders' best interests, and recommended stockholder adoption. Options are cashed out on the spread, out-of-the-money options cancelled, and RSUs addressed. A Delaware going-private, requiring a stockholder vote and appraisal-rights notice; watch for proxy timing, dissent levels, and any superior proposal.
